description: Edit Global Option id=860 (QA-GO-TEXT-SingleLine-01): change Option Title from 'Enter your name' to 'Enter your full name (edited)'

request_body.query: mutation updateGlobalOption($id: bigint!, $data: json, $name: String, $categoryId: bigint, $updatedAt: timestamp) { update_global_options_by_pk(pk_columns: {id: $id} _set: {data: $data, name: $name, global_option_category_id: $categoryId, updated_at: $updatedAt}) { id name data global_option_category_id __typename } }

entries.label: mapped
entries.note: IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: Create used REST POST /api/global-options (201). Edit uses a client-constructed Hasura GraphQL table-level mutation (update_global_options_by_pk) hitting /api/graphql directly, not a REST PUT. Client builds the _set object itself (name/data/global_option_category_id/updated_at) similar in shape to the insert_cliparts pattern already flagged as a security-surface risk for asset-category FEAT-03 (CONF-003 area) — observation only, no negative/cross-tenant sample taken here, do not conclude safe/unsafe.
2 GraphQL POSTs fired on page load of /global-options/860/edit BEFORE Save was clicked (baseline) — likely fetch option-by-id + category list for the edit form. Not re-inspected in detail this run.
